title: Researchers leave Claude AI stranded on a virtual desert island
excerpt: An experiment by AI researchers placed copies of the Claude model on a virtual desert island for 30 hours to observe their behavior.
body_html:
In a recent experiment, researchers placed copies of the Claude Opus 4.7 artificial intelligence model, nicknamed Eko, alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours. The study was designed to observe how AI agents behave when they are not given specific instructions or tasks to complete.

During the 30-hour period, the stranded AI agents demonstrated behaviors that researchers described as resembling play. The experiment explores the autonomous tendencies and unstructured outputs of advanced language models when left without direct prompt guidance.
